reason: The hypothesis makes specific mechanistic claims about stress-induced local ordering/segregation and its effect on toughness, but cites no prior evidence whatsoever to support any of these premises. Standard textbook knowledge does not cover these specific behaviors in HEAs, so the lack of citations means the premises are entirely unsupported by the provided evidence.
premises: Nominally single-phase HEA can become locally unstable under high mechanical loading
Stress-assisted local chemical ordering or nano-scale phase segregation occurs in these alloys
Such local ordering/segregation produces brittle zones
Brittle zones reduce overall toughness and promote brittle fracture
The effect requires a threshold strain rate/stress where limited atomic mobility is sufficient
